title: Velocity v1 expression
description: Essential: The final answer for v1 must be correctly expressed as v1 = qBR/(2m).

title: Lorentz force centripetal condition
description: Important: The solution must apply qvB = mv²/r to relate velocity, magnetic field, and trajectory radius.

title: Trajectory radius geometry
description: Important: The geometric relationship r1 = R tan(θ/2) = R/2 must be identified from the exit condition at N.

title: Maximum time expression
description: Essential: The final answer for maximum time must be correctly expressed as t_max = πm/(3qB).

title: Radius for velocity v2
description: Important: For v2 = 2qBR/m, the trajectory radius r2 = mv2/(qB) = 2R must be calculated.

title: Geometry for longest path
description: Important: The condition for the longest time (largest arc in the field) must involve the chord/inscribed angle geometry, leading to sin α = R/r2.

title: Total area expression
description: Essential: The final answer for the area must be correctly expressed as S = (11π/24 - √3/4)R².

title: Area decomposition
description: Important: The total area must be constructed from distinct regions (e.g., semicircle, sector, segment) based on particle trajectories.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect sign for the charge in the Lorentz force, or misidentifying the direction of curvature, should be penalized.

title: Unit or factor mistake
description: Pitfall: Dropping factors (like 1/2) in geometric relations (tan(θ/2)) or in area formulas should be penalized.
